messages:
Liam: heads up, spike in preempts in eu-west1b microzone, ~30 preempts last hour. Jobs needing 2 GPUs stuck Pending :eyes:
Sophia: any infra changes or scheduler flags flipped?
Liam: only a small kernel patch earlier. Not OOMs. Looks like placement failures/fragmentation.
Jordan: ran quick inventory: mixed shapes — a100-80g (4 nodes), a100-40g (8 nodes), a10g (12 nodes). many a10g are single-gpu. Pods request nvidia.com/gpu: 2 and expect local multi-gpu.
Akeem: also found `gpu-reserved=true:NoSchedule` taint on several nodes from the reserved-capacity script we ran last week. That carved out packable capacity.
Sophia: can you paste `kubectl describe` on one pending?
Jordan: events: `FailedScheduling: 0/24 nodes available: 14 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 10 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate.`
Liam: autoscaler triggered scale-up earlier but added a10g nodes (cheaper spot) which don't help 2-GPU placement.
autoscaler-bot: scale-up: +3 nodes (a10g) eu-west1b due to pending pods.
Sophia: exact issue: we have more GPU count but wrong shapes. Scheduler can place on a100-80g (2+ GPUs each) but autoscaler prefers cheapest. Result: fragmented free GPUs.
Akeem: options: 1) relax multi-gpu requirement (not acceptable for training/inference with NVLink); 2) force autoscaler preference for larger shapes; 3) temporarily remove `gpu-reserved` taints to increase fit.
Jordan: proposal: label big nodes `gpu-pool=multi` and add nodeAffinity in job templates for multi-gpu workloads. Also enable our `binpack-coalescing` feature in scheduler to treat spare single-GPU nodes as low-priority spill targets.
Liam: short-term emergency plan: pick 2 low-util reserved nodes, remove taint, cordon+drain gracefully to rebalance, then uncordon. Will that disrupt too many jobs?
Sophia: pick nodes with <30% utilization. Use `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=5m` then `kubectl uncordon`. Avoid nodes running critical infra.
Jordan: I'll map nodelist first: `kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}:{.labels.gpu-type}:{.status.allocatable.nvidia.com/gpu}
{end}'` then patch autoscaler config: `kubectl -n kube-system patch configmap cluster-autoscaler --type merge -p '{"data":{"prefer_large_shape":"true"}}'` (we have an internal flag that biases group selection).
Akeem: cost note: preferring a100-80g ups spend ~35%/hr during scale period, but eviction churn costs may exceed that. CFO flagged churn as bigger driver.
CFO-bot: alert: recent preempt churn estimated waste = $12k/day. Recommend short-term CAPEX to reduce churn.
Sophia: medium-term actions: 1) add instance-shape constraints to CA scaling policies per workload; 2) introduce nodeAffinity-based scheduling classes for multi-gpu; 3) add an admission webhook to reject 2-GPU pods unless they specify multi-gpu capable pool or tolerations.
Liam: also consider making reserved taints more flexible: `gpu-reserved=soft` where tolerant pods can opt-in via toleration. Less blunt.
Jordan: I can roll a canary: update one job's deployment with nodeAffinity to `gpu-pool=multi` and scale it. See if placement improves. If good, we upstream a small autoscaler policy change.
Akeem: will run the cost calc and present to ops-leads. If we change autoscaler preference, we should add temporary budget guardrails and close monitoring.
Sophia: runbook steps for on-call: 1) identify pending multi-gpu pods `kubectl get pods --field-selector=status.phase=Pending -o wide | grep -E "nvidia.com/gpu: 2"`; 2) check node shapes and taints; 3) if autoscaler added small nodes, patch CA to prefer larger shape; 4) if reserved taints blocking, pick minimal set of nodes to remove taint for 10m and rebalance.
Liam: any objections to doing the temporary taint removal + label big nodes and test nodeAffinity?
Jordan: no objections. I'll coordinate the patch, pick nodes during low-traffic window (in 15m).
Akeem: ping me before making autoscaler changes so I can run the cost delta.
Sophia: @everyone, keep messages short in this thread while we act to avoid noise.
Liam: thanks. Starting node map and taint list now.
(removed: thumbs-up reactions, short follow-ups and one-liners as we rebalance)
